description: For an infinite cardinal \(\kappa\) with \(|L|\le\kappa\), a satisfiable \(L\)-theory with no finite models is complete if any two of its models of cardinality \(\kappa\) are isomorphic. The countable-language case takes \(\kappa=\aleph_0\).
signature:
Cardinal.Categorical.isComplete.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (κ : Cardinal.{w}) (T : L.Theory)
  (h : κ.Categorical T) (h1 : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ)
  (h2 : Cardinal.lift.{w, max u v} L.card ≤ Cardinal.lift.{max u v, w} κ) (hS : T.IsSatisfiable)
  (hT : ∀ (M : T.ModelType), Infinite ↑M) : T.IsComplete
